# strip_url_for_use_as_referrer: the URL ("null" none) and the origin-only flag.

strip	null	origin
strip	https://user:pass@a.test:8080/p/q?x=1#frag	full
strip	https://user:pass@a.test:8080/p/q?x=1#frag	origin

strip	http://a.test/path	full
strip	http://a.test/path	origin
strip	about:blank	full
strip	about:blank	origin
strip	blob:https://a.test/uuid	full
strip	blob:https://a.test/uuid	origin
strip	data:,x	full
strip	data:,x	origin
strip	file:///etc/passwd	full
strip	file:///etc/passwd	origin

strip	javascript:alert(1)	origin

strip	https://a.test/p?q	origin

strip	resource://a/b	origin

strip	ftp://u@a.test/f	origin

strip	mailto:a@b.test	origin
